Name: m01_001
Speaker: rourke
Text: Lantern, Anvil. Kestrel 2-1 is down two blocks east of your drop, crew of three, beacon's still up. Hostiles are moving on it. Bring them home.

Name: m01_002
Speaker: alex
Text: Anvil, Lantern copies. Moving in two.

Name: m01_003
Speaker: chen
Text: AEGIS has the wreck. Beacon's steady. It's reading a dozen-plus on the approach, not confirmed.

Name: m01_005
Speaker: chen
Text: That's why I said not confirmed.

Name: m01_007
Speaker: alex
Text: Reyes. Dana Reyes. She flew us out of the harbor last spring.

Name: m01_009
Speaker: alex
Text: Out. Left side of the courtyard, under the arcade. Go.

Name: m01_012
Speaker: mercer
Text: Shooter's down or gone. Courtyard's ours.

Name: m01_015
Speaker: chen
Text: Wreck is there. Fastest way is the street, but that's where the contacts are. The block ahead goes six stories. Over the top and we come down on them.

Name: m01_017
Speaker: alex
Text: Over the top. Mercer, find me a door.

Name: m01_020
Speaker: mercer
Text: Regular. Not militia. Who sent regulars after a downed pilot?

Name: m01_025
Speaker: chen
Text: Clear. They were waiting on the stairs. They knew we'd come up.

Name: m01_027
Speaker: alex
Text: Bell, hold the stairwell. Nobody comes up behind us.

Name: m01_029
Speaker: mercer
Text: End of the hall, two doors, both open. They're in the apartments.

Name: m01_030
Speaker: alex
Text: Chen, with me. Mercer, the left door.

Name: m01_031
Speaker: mercer
Text: Stairs are gone. Ceiling came down. We go through the apartments.

Name: m01_032
Speaker: alex
Text: Mercer, that balcony. Move to it, I'll cover.

Name: m01_035
Speaker: bell
Text: Stairwell's quiet. I'm coming up. There's a family on two. Door's shut, kid's crying. I told them to keep it shut.

Name: m01_037
Speaker: chen
Text: Gun on the stairs. They set up for us. This is the choke.

Name: m01_038
Speaker: mercer
Text: There's a service door behind them. Hall's wall is just plaster.

Name: m01_040
Speaker: mercer
Text: Breaching the wall. Give me ten seconds and then come hard.

Name: m01_044
Speaker: chen
Text: That's the wreck. Smoke's from the engine, not the cabin. Beacon's still up.

Name: m01_046
Speaker: chen
Text: Mounted gun on the corner. They're facing the wreck, not us.

Name: m01_047
Speaker: mercer
Text: Then they haven't got in yet.

Name: m01_048
Speaker: alex
Text: Down the fire escape. Quiet until we're not.

Name: m01_055
Speaker: chen
Text: It's offering a route. Alley by the pharmacy, loading dock behind it, comes out on the gun's left where he can't turn fast.

Name: m01_057
Speaker: chen
Text: It's seen more than we have.

Name: m01_058
Speaker: alex
Text: Bell, Mercer, keep him looking at you. Chen, you're with me.

Name: m01_059
Speaker: chen
Text: It's showing a route, you're on it.

Name: m01_060
Speaker: chen
Text: Two in the dock. AEGIS called it.

Name: m01_061
Speaker: alex
Text: Then it's right. Take the left one.

Name: m01_064
Speaker: chen
Text: That was us. It drew the line. We walked it.

Name: m01_066
Speaker: bell
Text: Someone's still shooting from the wreck. Someone's alive.

Name: m01_067
Speaker: alex
Text: Lantern, moving to Kestrel. Don't shoot us, Kestrel.

Name: m01_069
Speaker: alex
Text: Anvil, we're at the wreck. Stand by.

Name: m01_071
Speaker: alex
Text: Ward. Lantern. Colonel Rourke sent us. How many?

Name: m01_072
Speaker: halvorsen
Text: Three. Okafor's in the back, leg's bad. Lieutenant's in the seat. She's pinned.

Name: m01_075
Speaker: bell
Text: The leg's bleeding. The lieutenant's pinned. Leg first.

Name: m01_076
Speaker: reyes
Text: Beacon's up. Fuel's off. I shut the fuel off.

Name: m01_077
Speaker: alex
Text: You did. It's Ward, Lieutenant. Harbor, last spring.

Name: m01_078
Speaker: reyes
Text: Ward. I can't feel my left foot.

Name: m01_080
Speaker: mercer
Text: Panel's on her. I can cut it, but if I cut wrong the seat frame drops. I need her stable and I need light.

Name: m01_081
Speaker: bell
Text: Okafor's tourniquet is holding. Reyes, I'm coming to you. Chen, how long until they come?

Name: m01_082
Speaker: chen
Text: They're already coming. Three directions. Four minutes, maybe less.

Name: m01_086
Speaker: alex
Text: Cabin door. Nothing gets in. Mercer, Chen, with me. We hold outside.

Name: m01_088
Speaker: chen
Text: North. Four. Walking in like they own it.

Name: m01_090
Speaker: bell
Text: Reyes, talk to me. Keep talking.

Name: m01_091
Speaker: reyes
Text: Kestrel 2-1, lift checklist. Fuel, off. Battery --

Name: m01_093
Speaker: chen
Text: Second group, east. They're splitting us.

Name: m01_094
Speaker: mercer
Text: East is open! Ward, east is open!

Name: m01_095
Speaker: mercer
Text: I've got east. I've got east, don't move for me.

Name: m01_096
Speaker: bell
Text: Two minutes. Two minutes and the panel's hers.

Name: m01_097
Speaker: chen
Text: All three. And they brought the gun.

Name: m01_099
Speaker: chen
Text: Bus. They want the bus. It sees the cabin door.

Name: m01_100
Speaker: alex
Text: Then the bus is where we are.

Name: m01_102
Speaker: bell
Text: Halvorsen, you shoot, I'll work. One minute.

Name: m01_103
Speaker: reyes
Text: Battery, off. Rotor brake -- I don't remember the next one.

Name: m01_104
Speaker: bell
Text: Then say the first one again.

Name: m01_105
Speaker: mercer
Text: Shield on the right! He's going for the cabin!

Name: m01_106
Speaker: alex
Text: Flank him. Mercer, make him turn.

Name: m01_109
Speaker: bell
Text: Panel's loose! Mercer, I need the cutter and I need it now!

Name: m01_111
Speaker: chen
Text: Ward, I've got something on the lens. Something further out.

Name: m01_112
Speaker: chen
Text: Mortar. Parking deck, three hundred out. They're setting up on us.

Name: m01_115
Speaker: chen
Text: It's already asking. It's got a strike package on it. It wants a confirm.

Name: m01_119
Speaker: mercer
Text: Did you see that? Did you --

Name: m01_120
Speaker: chen
Text: Mortar's gone. Deck's gone. AEGIS, confirmed kill.

Name: m01_121
Speaker: bell
Text: Good. Panel's off. Reyes is out of the seat.

Name: m01_122
Speaker: halvorsen
Text: You've got a guardian angel, Ward.

Name: m01_124
Speaker: rourke
Text: Lantern, Anvil. We saw the strike. Say status.

Name: m01_125
Speaker: alex
Text: Anvil, Lantern. Three crew, three alive. We're bringing them home.

Name: m01_126
Speaker: rourke
Text: Extraction's two blocks south, the rail yard. It won't wait long. Move, Lantern.

Name: m01_128
Speaker: mercer
Text: I've got him. Okafor, hands around my neck. Don't let go, whatever I do.

Name: m01_131
Speaker: alex
Text: Chen, you're our eyes. I'm point. Nobody shoots past the wounded.

Name: m01_133
Speaker: chen
Text: We go under the deck. Fast. AEGIS says the floor above is still moving.

Name: m01_136
Speaker: halvorsen
Text: Well. We're not going back that way.

Name: m01_138
Speaker: chen
Text: Contacts in the containers. Six, eight. They're between us and the yard.

Name: m01_139
Speaker: alex
Text: Bell, Mercer, get them into the container on the left. Halvorsen, the door. Chen, with me.

Name: m01_140
Speaker: bell
Text: Moving them. Reyes, in. Okafor, Gabe's got you.

Name: m01_143
Speaker: mercer
Text: I'm out here with you, Ward. Okafor's down safe.

Name: m01_144
Speaker: rourke
Text: Lantern, Anvil's on the cab. Get them aboard.

Name: m01_146
Speaker: alex
Text: Reyes first. Then Okafor. Then everyone.

Name: m01_147
Speaker: bell
Text: Reyes, up. Okafor, Gabe's lifting you. Halvorsen --

Name: m01_151
Speaker: bell
Text: Okafor keeps the leg. Reyes has two broken bones in her foot and she's already asked when she can fly. I told her to ask you.

Name: m01_153
Speaker: bell
Text: She said you'd say no. You've got a cut over your eye. Sit.

Name: m01_154
Speaker: reyes
Text: Ward. You came over the top of a six-story building for me.

Name: m01_156
Speaker: reyes
Text: Thank you. All of you. I'll say it to each of them. I'm saying it to you first.

Name: m01_157
Speaker: alex
Text: Get your foot fixed. We'll need a pilot.

Name: m01_159
Speaker: chen
Text: Twelve seconds from confirm to impact. Nothing we carry does that.

Name: m01_161
Speaker: chen
Text: It did. It had the package ready before I asked. That's -- that's good. That's what it's for.

Name: m01_162
Speaker: mercer
Text: Halvorsen says I breach like a man who hates doors.

Name: m01_164
Speaker: mercer
Text: Doors, walls. Something's always in the way.

Name: m01_165
Speaker: halvorsen
Text: Ward. You've got a sister in the service? Pilot I knew flew with a Ward. Mara Ward. Years back.

Name: m01_166
Speaker: alex
Text: Different Ward. Get some sleep, Chief.

Name: m01_167
Speaker: rourke
Text: Good work, Alex. Regulars were on that wreck before we were. I've asked why.

Name: m01_182
Speaker: mercer
Text: Shield. Flank him, he turns slow.

Name: m01_184
Speaker: mercer
Text: Shield up front -- hit him from the side.

Name: m01_187
Speaker: mercer
Text: That's the gun. Stay out of its lane.

Name: m01_200
Speaker: bell
Text: Chen's down. I can't reach him.

Name: m01_232
Speaker: mercer
Text: Charge going on. Give me room.

Name: m01_239
Speaker: chen
Text: That's the last one. For now.

Name: m01_249
Speaker: chen
Text: AEGIS has a line for us.
